questions.question: When the Israelites grumbled in their tents about entering the land, why did they say the LORD brought them out of Egypt?

answers.text: To hand them over to the Amorites
To make them servants in the wilderness
To scatter them among the nations

questions.question: After Israel refused to enter the promised land, what did the LORD swear about the men of that generation?

answers.text: Not one of them would see the good land
They must wait one more year to go in
They must build cities in the wilderness

questions.question: What did the LORD say would happen to the Israelite children the people claimed would become captives?

answers.text: They would enter and possess the land
They would grow up back in Egypt
They would return to Horeb with Moses

questions.question: After Israel refused to enter the land, why did the LORD tell them not to go up and fight?

answers.text: The LORD was not with them
The Amorites had asked for peace
